question: What chapter concludes the nine-story arrangement in the Aṃśumatkāśyapa text?
premises: The chapter treats the arrangement of nine stories and is numbered thirty-fifth.
inference: This marks the conclusion of the thirty-fifth chapter on the nine-story arrangement in the Aṃśumatkāśyapa.
plain_english: Thus ends the thirty-fifth chapter, on the arrangement of nine stories, in the Aṃśumatkāśyapa.
